note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo_remark: 'May need to check if email permission needs to be granted' (cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck. The same eNotification cron sends the email reminder to companies for stage RR3: notices are picked through the due-date window, merged per UEN, template RR3_EMAIL_COMPANY[_COMBINED] is picked from the stage. Not proven: the sentence referring to the 3rd letter (it lives in the DB template) and real delivery, because in PROD cron.notification.enabled=false, email.enableSmtp=false and ENOTIFICATION is not in email.smtp.allowedSources. recommendation: Claim partially. Collecting, merging per UEN, per-stage templates and sending the email exist, but they are switched off in PROD and the sentence referring to the 3rd letter lives only in a DB template. Show the content of template RR3_EMAIL_COMPANY and one RR3 email sent in UAT

steps.step: OCMS collects outstanding company notices at stage RR3 for the day's batch
steps.detail: The eNotification job calls queryRecordsForReminder() (NJ:162) and tags each row with the stage taken from last_processing_stage (NJ:170-180). The query selects notices with last_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), offender_indicator Y, not in the exclusion list, with no notification record yet for the same stage, and whose due date (last_processing_date + parameters POS + PDD) falls within the ENOTEDAYS window from today (NH:1109-1114, 1135-1160). So an RR3 notice is picked once its due date is close, matching the story words 'fines that will be due soon'. The values of ENOTEDAYS/POS/PDD live in the DB, cannot verify from repo. Vehicle types I, D, V are excluded (NH:1151).

steps.step: OCMS identifies the unique company UEN among the notices in the batch
steps.detail: combineNotices(records) (NJ:191) groups through getRecipientKey: for a company the key is 'B_' + UEN (NH:2230-2245) (NH:2230-2245). But compositeKey = recipientKey + '_' + stage + '_' + paymentDueDate (NH:2178), so the same company UEN with a different due date or stage becomes a separate group and can still receive more than one message on the same day. The story asks for one unique recipient per batch, same finding as OCMS9.7.

steps.step: Only companies (ID type B) with an email address are used for email; IDs on the exclusion list are skipped
steps.detail: idType B decides the EMAIL channel (NH:448-457; NJ:353-354). validateContactInfo rejects a company without an email (NH:2272-2281). IDs on the exclusion list are skipped before sending (NJ:226) and companies stay out of the SMS batch (NH:1544). This matches 'unique company vehicle owners'.

steps.step: The email lists the outstanding notices combined per company
steps.detail: Non-ENA notices of one UEN are merged (combinedNotices joined with '.', amountPayable summed, NH:2182-2200). prepareTemplateData passes noticeCount and combinedNotices to the template (NH:410-433); generateMessages picks <STAGE>_EMAIL_COMPANY with the suffix _COMBINED when there is more than one notice (NH:284-301, 459-475). Stages DN1, DN2, DR3 get no email because the company template is missing (NH:311-317), but RR3 is not among them. The template content cannot be verified from repo. Same fit as OCMS9.7.

steps.step: The email refers to the 3rd letter reminder
steps.detail: The code only picks the template name from the stage: RR3_EMAIL_COMPANY or RR3_EMAIL_COMPANY_COMBINED (NH:459-475). If the template is missing, the email is skipped with a log (NJ:383-384). No code inserts a reference to the third letter; that depends on the template content in ocms_template_store, which is not in the repo (cannot verify from repo).

steps.step: OCMS sends the email reminder to the company
steps.detail: The job calls notificationHelper.sendEmail (NJ:388), which calls EmailService with source ENOTIFICATION (NH:574-576). But in PROD: cron.notification.enabled=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), email.enableSmtp=false (application-prod.properties:80) and email.smtp.allowedSources does not contain ENOTIFICATION (application-prod.properties:81), so EmailService returns false (EMS:64-72). In UAT ENOTIFICATION is in the allowlist (application-uat.properties:79). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180: 'Awaiting eNotification cron to activate'. Real email delivery cannot be verified from repo.
